newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Oct 30.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on October 30. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. Telephone: (6221) 384-6364. Fax: (6221) 344-8404.

Members of the Indonesian National Youth Committee have threatened to pull out of the organisation. Four youth organisations said that the committee has become a vehicle for Indonesia's ruling Golkar party.
Foreign cargo planes will be restricted to landing at Batam Island's Hang Nadim airport, Transport Minister Haryanto Dhanutirto said.

A lieutenant in the Indonesian police force has admitted hitting a man arrested on charges of robbery who later died in police custody. The matter is under investigation by Indonesia's National Commission on Human Rights.
Indonesia will face difficulties exporting its textile products in the year 2000 due to weak investment in new capital stock in the sector, an official with the country's textile association said.
